purpose: Advisory scoring matrix for the universal six gate organ maturity model.

gates.title: Identity & Jurisdiction

minimum_evidence_for_score.1: Gate has a draft document or declared field.
minimum_evidence_for_score.2: Gate has evidence paths mapped to claims.
minimum_evidence_for_score.3: Gate evidence includes working action, validator or receipt where applicable.
minimum_evidence_for_score.4: Gate is checked by an external organ or cross-organ validator.
minimum_evidence_for_score.5: Gate has local crown confirmation and explicit anti-global-readiness boundary.

gates.risk_if_overstated: anonymous folder, role confusion, authority creep

anti_fake_green_rules: No score increment without evidence path.
No local score may mutate global assembled/core readiness directly.
Self-validator PASS can raise hygiene, not external trust.
Warnings must affect risk debt unless explicitly waived by Owner.
Game XP must be downstream of receipts, never upstream of truth.
